text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示词插件，会在 system prompt 中加入一段执行强度提示，并提供插件管理页配置卡、promptboost 工具和 /dsh-boost 命令。它支持启停注入、配置自定义提示、追加文本，以及运行时临时覆盖或恢复提示。提示按临时覆盖、配置文本、内置核心的顺序选取，适合希望调整 DSH 助手执行纪律的用户。无需 API Key 或外部服务。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost adds a configurable execution prompt to DSH. A web settings card, promptboost tool, and /dsh-boost command let users toggle it, edit or append text, and set temporary overrides. It needs no API key or external service.
想给 DSH 的系统提示加一段强调执行和验证的指引
能不能在插件管理页自定义助手的提示文本？
我想临时改一下当前会话进程使用的系统提示
让 DSH 可以随时开关一段额外的执行规范
怎么给内置提示追加一条自己的要求？
希望通过命令查看或切换提示注入状态
I want to customize an execution-focused instruction in the DSH system prompt.
Can I temporarily override and reset the prompt while the host is running?
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 的功能「系统提示注入」：在 DSH 的 system prompt 中注册执行强度提示段，位置对齐 PLAN_POLICY；可通过 enabled 配置关闭注入。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 的功能「提示来源选择」：按运行时临时覆盖、配置卡 prompt、内置核心的优先级选取文本，并可将 extraText 追加到末尾。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 的功能「运行时控制」：通过 promptboost 工具或 /dsh-boost 命令查询状态、开关提示、临时替换文本或恢复原文本，修改仅作用于当前进程。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 的功能「管理页配置」：在插件管理器的配置页面编辑启用状态、完整提示文本和追加文本，保存后当前实例即可读取更新值。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 提供工具 promptboost：查看/开关执行强度提示，或临时改写了提示文本（运行期生效）。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 提供命令 dsh-boost：执行强度提示：查看 / 开关 / 改文本（运行期生效）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 提供设置项 enabled：总开关：关掉就不注入任何提示
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 提供设置项 prompt：自定义提示文本；留空 = 用内置核心
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost 提供设置项 extraText：追加在内置核心之后，可留空

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · dsh-mdl-promptboost：DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that injects a small, engineered **execution-intensity prompt** into the system prompt. It favors verified work over thrift: run the checks, report the conclusion first, and do not claim something was verified unless it was.

The plugin adds a configuration card to the DSH plugin manager, a runtime tool named `promptboost`, and the `/dsh-boost` slash command.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · Install：Install it as a DSH bundle with the DSH plugin manager, or from this repository:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add --ignore-scripts "github:ggfgfgf-on/dsh-mdl-promptboost"
```

For a reproducible install, pin the commit:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add --ignore-scripts "github:ggfgfgf-on/dsh-mdl-promptboost#<commit-sha>"
```

Verify that the bundle patch inserted its row:

```powershell
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config
```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · Install：Expected row id: `mdl-promptboost`.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · Configuration：Open the plugin manager page and select **执行强度提示**. The host-owned form writes three keys:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. When off, nothing is injected. |
| `prompt` | `""` | Full replacement text. Empty means use the built-in core. |
| `extraText` | `""` | Appended after the selected prompt; may be empty. |

The bundled patch sets `enabled: true` and leaves the two text fields at their defaults.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · Runtime control：Slash command:

```text
/dsh-boost                     show current state and source
/dsh-boost on                  enable
/dsh-boost off                 disable
/dsh-boost text <new text>     temporary runtime override

Model tool:

```text
promptboost({ enabled?: "on" | "off", text?: string })
```

`text: ""` clears the runtime override. Runtime changes live for the current host process; they are not persisted.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · How it works：- `lib/index.js` declares the bundle, config schema, host-side system-prompt section, tool, and command.
- `lib/client.js` registers the row configuration card on the plugin manager page.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `mdl-promptboost` row into the DSH composition.

The prompt is read lazily on every render, so changes from the configuration card or runtime controls take effect in the same process.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mdl-promptboost README · Repository layout：```text
lib/index.js        host-side plugin, prompt injection, tool, command
lib/client.js       plugin-manager configuration card
cordis.patch.yml    bundle patch (one row)
package.json        package and DSH manifest metadata
